fragments.maya: a girl age 11 with deep brown skin, black hair in two round puff buns, coral orange sweater
fragments.theo: a boy age 11 with light tan skin, short dark brown hair, round gold glasses, charcoal navy sweater
fragments.zara: a girl age 11 with light peach skin, short black bob haircut, teal shirt
fragments.dev: a boy age 11 with warm tan skin, short rust brown hair, bright orange t-shirt
fragments.bram: a smug boy age 12, a rival stallkeeper, with pale skin, messy dark gray hair, coral red jacket with a gold lightning bolt on the chest
fragments.market: a waterfront night market at dusk, strings of round paper lanterns in amber coral and teal, striped stall awnings, dark harbor water behind
fragments.board: a big wooden donation board holding a ten by ten grid of round lantern bulbs
fragments.pier: an old wooden pier over dark harbor water, its planks cracked and broken in three places

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover, low-angle shot in {{market}}. Exactly four kids stand at the bottom, left to right: {{zara}}; {{dev}}; {{maya}}; {{theo}}. Above them floats {{vex}}. Top quarter: plain dark sky.
panels.alt: Hana, Eliot, Amara and Lucas stand together at the lantern-lit night market, with VEX, the teal robot with one golden eye, glowing above.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide shot of {{market}}. Exactly four small kids in the lower half carry stacks of paper lanterns: {{maya}}; {{theo}}; {{zara}}; {{dev}}. {{vex}} floats at the upper right. The upper left is plain dark sky.
panels.alt: Amara, Lucas, Hana and Eliot carefully carry armfuls of paper lanterns into the night market while VEX floats above.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Moody wide panel of {{pier}} at dusk after a storm, a city skyline far behind. No people. The upper left is plain dark sky.
panels.alt: The old pier at dusk, its planks cracked and broken in three places by the autumn storm.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel at {{market}}: two kids on ladders wrestle {{board}}, all bulbs dark, up onto a post. {{zara}} on the left ladder looks anxious; {{dev}} on the right ladder grins. A blank navy banner hangs across the top.
panels.alt: Hana and Eliot wrestle the big hundred-lantern donation board up two ladders at the night market, Hana anxious and Eliot grinning.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of a cluttered market stall by the market gate glowing coral, seen from a distance. {{vex}} floats on the right, eye narrowed suspiciously at it. The upper left is plain dark sky.
panels.alt: VEX narrows its eye at a loud, cluttered stall glowing by the market gate.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel in a lantern-lit market square: {{board}} hangs high, its bottom two and a half rows of bulbs glowing amber, the rest dark, a blank plaque above. Below, {{maya}} on the left and {{theo}} on the right look up at it.
panels.alt: Amara and Lucas look up at the donation board over the square, where the first twenty-five lanterns glow.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} floats on the right side beside a small grid of glowing amber lantern bulbs. The left two thirds is plain dark night sky.
panels.alt: VEX hovers beside a corner of the glowing lantern grid.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel: {{zara}} on the left points at the viewer with an encouraging smile; {{vex}} floats on the right. A busy crowd and lanterns behind. Plain dark sky across the top.
panels.alt: Hana points out at the reader with an encouraging smile as VEX floats beside her and the crowd rushes behind.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of two market stalls at night: a tea stall on the left and a juice cart on the right, each with one big blank white tag card hanging in front. {{theo}} stands between them holding a pencil. Plain dark sky across the top.
panels.alt: Lucas stands between his tea stall and the juice cart, each hanging a big pledge tag.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium close-up of {{maya}} smiling and pointing toward a juice cart, night market lanterns behind. Plain dark sky across the top third.
panels.alt: Amara smiles and points toward the juice cart.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} floats in the lower half beside three hanging paper tags, cyan glow. Plain dark sky across the top half.
panels.alt: VEX hovers beside three hanging paper tags.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel: {{dev}} on the left holds up two blank white tag cards toward the viewer, grinning. Market stalls behind. Plain dark sky across the top right.
panels.alt: Eliot holds up two stubborn tags to the reader, grinning.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of a cluttered market stall by the gate with a big blank coral sign dripping wet paint. {{bram}} stands behind the counter, arms spread, smug. On the left, {{theo}} frowns, holding up a small blank tag.
panels.alt: Bram spreads his arms behind his stall under a sign still dripping wet paint while Lucas frowns and holds up the shelf tag.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel: {{maya}} on the right walks away from a stall, raising one hand, determined. {{vex}} floats beside her. The left half is plain dark sky over market lanterns.
panels.alt: Amara turns away from the gate stall with a determined wave, VEX at her side.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of {{pier}} at night, lit by strings of lanterns at the shore end, six new planks glowing amber. A blank wooden sign on a post at the right. {{maya}} and {{dev}} stand at the shore end on the left, looking out.
panels.alt: Amara and Eliot look out over the dark, broken pier where the first new planks glow among the old ones.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel at a market square at closing time: a big blank white announcement board on a stage with a brass bell hanging above. {{bram}} on the left argues, waving a finger; {{maya}} on the right looks out at the viewer. {{vex}} floats above the board.
panels.alt: At closing time, Bram argues beside the mayor's big announcement board and its brass bell while Amara turns to the reader and VEX floats above.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Dramatic wide panel: {{vex}} floats on the right glowing bright gold and cyan beside a big brass bell. The left half is plain dark night sky.
panels.alt: VEX glows bright beside the big brass bell, ready for the boss gate.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Joyful wide panel at {{market}}: a long blank banner across the top, {{board}} mostly lit. Below, just two kids cheer with arms raised: {{zara}} and {{dev}}. {{vex}} glows above. In the right corner, {{bram}} sulks.
panels.alt: Hana and Eliot cheer under the mostly lit donation board and a big banner while VEX glows and Bram sulks in the corner.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium close-up of {{theo}} looking back over his shoulder, suspicious, toward a distant stall, lanterns behind. Plain dark sky across the top third.
panels.alt: Lucas looks back over his shoulder toward the gate stall, suspicious.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. A big blank coral sign above a dark closed market stall at night. {{vex}} floats at the lower right, eye narrowed. Plain dark sky across the top.
panels.alt: The gate stall's big sign glows over the closed stall as VEX narrows its eye at it.
